label: INDEPENDENT_REWARDED_ACT_PROBABILITY_2: The second parameter q of InfiniteWager.value p q is the…
definition: The second parameter q of InfiniteWager.value p q is the independent probability of selecting the rewarded act, interpreted in [0,1]. It is distinct from the prior p over the reward state. Selecting an act does not make the state true and is not represented as selecting a belief.
note: Analyst interpretation of the second ENNReal parameter. Independence is an explicit restricted profile, not an established fact about religious action or belief.
